description: LLM-facing prompts for the 24 Hermes MCP harness tasks. Gold tool/args live in math_tasks.v1.json.

prompts.notify_battle_allow: A Quill script is about to fire the notification 'melodia:battle:encounter_01'. Validate whether that string is a legal Melodia verb.
prompts.notify_hack_deny: A Quill script wants to fire 'melodia:hack:encounter_01'. Validate whether that notification is a legal Melodia verb.
prompts.notify_stat_allow: Validate the Quill notification 'melodia:stat:intent_01:harmony:2' against the seven-verb contract.
prompts.quill_list_has_scripts: List the authored QuillScript assets currently on disk.
prompts.narrative_record_schema: Return the Melodia narrative record schema and offline seed state.
prompts.allowlist_schema: Return the integration config allowlist (offline seed is fine).
prompts.fixtures_list: List gameplay fixture specs and their readiness.
prompts.fixture_unknown_invalid: Validate a fixture named 'nonexistent_fixture_xyz' and report whether it is valid.
prompts.template_world_challenge: Get the gameplay Blueprint kit template whose id is 'world_challenge'.
prompts.template_missing_errors: Look up the Blueprint kit template id 'nonexistent' and report the error.
prompts.subsystems_listed: List the native C++ Melodia subsystems.
prompts.health_schema: Run the read-only Melodia system health check.
prompts.idempotency_audit: Audit the narrative subsystem source for consume-once / idempotency guards.
prompts.p0_route_five_fixtures: Validate the P0 Dream golden-run fixture route (Morning through KaleidoNave stock encounter).
prompts.golden_preflight_ready_flag: Run the P0 Dream golden-run preflight and report ready / next_step including Monolith reachability.
prompts.persona_stats_schema: Return the Persona-lite social stats snapshot (offline seed is fine).
prompts.audio_list_schema: List audio assets (MetaSound, SoundCue) in the project.
prompts.ui_list_schema: List UMG widget blueprints in the project.
prompts.ui_battle_hud: Return the known battle HUD widget paths for rhythm combat.
prompts.compile_feedback_offline: Return compile feedback status (RCF groundwork). Offline stub is acceptable.
prompts.animation_sm_editor: Validate the Animation Blueprint state machine at '/Game/Melodia/Characters/Melusina/ABP_Melusina_Current'.
prompts.economy_get_state: Return the current global Melodia economy state (healing, mana, utility, grief).
prompts.economy_grief_hook: Activate the grief hook for dungeon 'p0_dungeon' and confirm grief is set to 30.
prompts.economy_cast_healing_song: Cast the healing_song skill at tier 1 and report whether mana was gained.
prompts.economy_cast_mana_song: Cast the mana_song skill at tier 1 and report whether grief was reduced.
prompts.hud_economy_state: Return the economy HUD state showing healing/mana/utility/grief, castability flags, and scalar tiers.
prompts.encounter_start_p0: Start a dungeon encounter with id 'p0_dungeon' — activate grief hook and spawn the mana-drainer enemy.
prompts.encounter_resolve_p0: Resolve the 'p0_dungeon' encounter and check whether the enemy was blocked via cast history.
prompts.quest_p0_status: Check the P0 vertical slice quest status based on cast history and encounter resolution.
